title: Walk, match, clean up
prompt:
1. `static List<String> findLogs(Path root)` — walk the tree depth 3, collect the
FILE NAMES (not full paths) of every regular file ending in .log, SORTED
alphabetically. Use try-with-resources on the stream.
2. `static long totalBytes(Path root)` — sum file sizes of regular files at ANY
depth (Files.size; skip directories).
3. `static boolean globMatches(String pattern, Path candidate)` — use
`FileSystems.getDefault().getPathMatcher("glob:" + pattern)` and
`matcher.matches(candidate)`.

tests.name: tree walked, names collected
tests.hint: Depth does not hide files; extensions filter.

tests.name: glob semantics
